Looks.detail.loadErrorTitle: The look could not be loaded
Looks.detail.notFoundDescription: There is neither a look definition nor a set-price discount for the key "{key}".
Looks.detail.soldOutAlertTitle: {piece} is sold out in every size
Looks.detail.soldOutAlertDescription: A set needs every piece in one size. The set cannot be bought at the set price.
Looks.detail.driftDescription: The single prices changed since the look was set up: the discount no longer lands on the stored set price.
Looks.detail.staleTitle: Set price not yet updated in the shop
Looks.detail.staleDescription: The discount is changed, the look definition is not yet. Please try again.
Looks.detail.errNotPositive: Please enter a set price above 0
Looks.detail.errNotBelowSum: The set price must be below the sum of the single prices ({sum})
Looks.detail.errSumNotLive: The single prices changed. Please reload the page.
Looks.detail.errPieces: At least one piece has no price or is not loaded.
Looks.detail.completeMissingObject: The look definition for this set-price discount is missing. Completing creates it from the discount. The look stays as it is.
Looks.detail.completeMissingDiscount: The set-price discount for this look definition is missing. Completing creates it inactive. The look stays switched off.
Looks.detail.completeInconsistent: The look definition and the set-price discount name different pieces. The look cannot be switched here; please check it in the Merchant Center.
Looks.detail.deleteDescription: Removes the look definition, the discounts of all countries and the discount group. This cannot be undone.
Looks.detail.deleteActiveWarning: The look is on: its discounts disappear from the shop at once.
Looks.detail.errPercent: The saving must be above 0% and below 100%
Looks.detail.errModeMixed: Per country a look uses either amounts or one percentage
